create.name: Stephen Cope
create.bio:
Stephen Cope is a writer and yoga teacher whose work brings together the contemplative traditions of the East and the psychology of the West. For close to thirty years he has been Scholar-in-Residence at Kripalu, the large yoga and retreat centre in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, where he also founded and for a time directed the Kripalu Institute for Extraordinary Living, a research programme studying how yoga and meditation work. He trained as a psychotherapist before he came to live and teach at Kripalu.

His books try to make classic yoga texts usable for ordinary readers. Yoga and the Quest for the True Self and The Wisdom of Yoga explore the philosophy and psychology of the path; The Great Work of Your Life reads the Bhagavad Gita as a guide to finding one's dharma, or calling,, and The Dharma in Difficult Times carries that theme into periods of loss and change. Soul Friends looks at the friendships that shape a life, and Dharma Dog, a memoir, tells what raising a spaniel puppy in his seventies taught him about love. As a teacher he pairs close study of texts with hatha yoga and mindfulness practice, and he often teaches lovingkindness meditation with Sharon Salzberg. He also offers an eight-week online course on finding one's calling.

books.title: The Great Work of Your Life: A Guide for the Journey to Your True Calling
books.author: Stephen Cope
books.description: Uses the Bhagavad Gita, the dialogue between the archer Arjuna and his teacher Krishna, as a step-by-step map for discovering one's dharma, or deep purpose.

books.title: Yoga and the Quest for the True Self
books.author: Stephen Cope
books.description: His first book, a lively account of yoga as a path of liberation rather than exercise, drawing on his years living at Kripalu and his background in psychotherapy.

books.title: The Wisdom of Yoga: A Seeker's Guide to Extraordinary Living
books.author: Stephen Cope
books.description: An introduction to the deeper teachings of the yoga tradition on the causes of suffering, on freedom and on what a fully lived life might look like.

books.title: The Dharma in Difficult Times: Finding Your Calling in Times of Loss, Change, Struggle, and Doubt
books.author: Stephen Cope
books.description: Picking up where The Great Work of Your Life left off, it argues that times of crisis can clarify a person's purpose instead of knocking them off course.

books.title: Soul Friends: The Transforming Power of Deep Human Connection
books.author: Stephen Cope
books.description: Explores the handful of close friendships that shape who we become, and what makes such connections so formative.

books.title: Dharma Dog: When Your Spiritual Teacher Has Four Legs
books.author: Stephen Cope
books.description: A memoir of helping to raise a spaniel puppy in his seventies, and of the lessons in love and ageing it brought him.

courses.title: Your True Calling: Essential Teachings of Yoga to Find Your Path in the World
courses.description: An eight-week online course built on the Bhagavad Gita, with video sessions filmed at Kripalu, recorded question-and-answer sessions, guided meditation and journaling prompts for finding one's calling.
courses.price: $97 single payment (limited time), or 3 payments of $35
